items.title: Build-to-rent homes could appeal to young S’poreans, but can rent be kept under $2,000?
items.description: Can build-to-rent homes in Singapore stay under $2,000 a month? What young renters, future buyers and landlords should check.

items.title: Why Singapore is exploring build-to-rent
items.description: Why Singapore is looking at build-to-rent homes, and what that means for people who rent now and hope to buy later.

items.title: 1,310 flats in Sembawang with under 3 years’ wait to go on sale in Nov
items.description: About 1,310 Sembawang HDB flats with a wait under three years go on sale in November. What buyers and sellers should check.

items.title: Thomson Reserve sells 90% of units at average of S$2,900 psf over launch weekend
items.description: Thomson Reserve sold about 90% at roughly $2,900 psf on launch weekend. What Singapore condo buyers and nearby sellers should compare.

items.title: New mall, parks and plans for a school under Toa Payoh West masterplan
items.description: Toa Payoh West plans include a mall, parks, a school and about 1,600 BTO flats near Caldecott MRT. What is real today versus still a plan.

items.title: Ex-condo chairman loses defamation suit over undisclosed links
items.description: A former condo chairman lost a defamation case over undisclosed links. What Singapore condo buyers and council members should ask.

items.title: Private home launch pipeline set to climb to 14-year high in 2027
items.description: Singapore’s private home launch pipeline may hit a 14-year high in 2027. More choice is not the same as lower prices.

items.title: Hao Mart founder halts foreclosure of his Jervois Hill bungalow by OG
items.description: A Jervois Hill bungalow foreclosure was halted. What one landed loan story does, and does not, say about Singapore property prices.

items.title: Hong Leong, TID place top bid of S$181.86m or S$1,755 psf ppr for Orchard plot
items.description: Hong Leong and TID bid $181.86 million for an Orchard plot, about $1,755 psf ppr. Why that land price is not a condo price.

items.title: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks to get HIP upgrade after re-poll
items.description: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks will get HIP after a fresh poll. What the upgrade covers, what owners pay, and what buyers should still check.

items.title: Tampines is S’pore’s most populous planning area, but not its fastest-growing
items.description: Tampines has the most people of any planning area, but Punggol and Sengkang grew faster. How to choose a mature town or a growing one.

items.title: About 11,000 homes planned on Maju Forest, Gillman Barracks sites with more greenery to be retained
items.description: About 11,000 homes are planned at Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks, mostly public housing. What nearby buyers and sellers should treat as a long-term plan.
